name: Wild Card Gang

features.name: Card-rank merging
features.description: Jacks, queens, kings and aces merge upward.

review:
A surreal crime drama in the style of gritty TV gang shows, on BGaming's Merge Up engine – using card ranks, so jacks merge into queens, then kings, then aces. Very easy to follow.

Clusters pay and merge, and free spins use cell multipliers. Very high volatility, a 5,000x max and an excellent 97.25% RTP, with free spins about once every 276 spins. A stylish take on Merge Up.
pros: Excellent 97.25% RTP – among the highest published

cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
